description: This file contains the PHP class 'Bestseller' which extends the 'Product' model class within the Opencart catalog extension modules. It implements a method to retrieve best-selling products with caching and SQL query logic.

classes.name: Bestseller
classes.description: A model class responsible for fetching the best-selling products in the Opencart catalog extension modules, extending the general Product model.

methods.name: getBestSellers
methods.description: Retrieves the list of best-selling products up to the specified limit, utilizing caching for performance optimization.
